nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The Outlier Detection model uses an adversarial auto-encoder (AAE). The Brain Age model uses support vector regression (SVR), but SVR is not listed in the extraction categories.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The Outlier Detection model uses an adversarial auto-encoder (AAE), a deep learning approach that has shown promising results in clinical neuroimaging.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study models relative brain region volumes (ROIrel) from 101 brain regions: 68 cortical regions (34 per hemisphere) from the Desikan-Killiany atlas and 33 subcortical/other structures from the ASEG atlas in FreeSurfer. The ROIrel values were calculated by dividing original brain region volumes by total intracranial volume (TIV). Cortical regions include volumes from gyri and cortical structures, while subcortical regions include structures such as hippocampus, amygdala, caudate, putamen, pallidum, thalamus, cerebellum, ventricles, and corpus callosum.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The cortical surface was parcellated using the Desikan-Killiany cortical atlas and segmented into 68 cortical regions (34 per hemisphere). An additional 33 neuroanatomical structures were extracted using the ASEG atlas in FreeSurfer totalling 101 brain regions (ROIs)... We estimated the relative brain region volumes (ROIrel) for each subject by dividing the original brain region volumes by the total intracranial volume

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and Sex were used as conditional variables in the AAE model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: To further account for the effect of demographics variables, age and sex were added to the model such that the AAE was conditioned to learn a latent representation whilst taking into account this information.
